ائتنسن (form VIII)
# اِئْتَنَسْنَ (iʔtanasna) /iʔ.ta.nas.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِئْتَنَسَ (iʔtanasa)
# اِئْتَنِسْنَ (iʔtanisna) /iʔ.ta.nis.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِئْتَنَسَ (iʔtanasa)
